fire: Pour the batter into a tin. Bake for 45 minutes.
Cover the pot, and cook for 20 minutes.
Stir in the rice, lower the heat, and simmer.
Add the beans and cook until soft.
Spread on a tray. Bake until crisp.
Reduce the heat and cook, stirring, for 5 minutes.
Season the chicken, then roast for one hour.
Bring the soup to a boil and cook for 10 minutes.
quiet: Pour the batter into a bowl. Let it rest for 45 minutes.
Cover the pot, and put it in the fridge.
Stir in the rice, then serve with a spoon.
Add the beans and serve at once.
Spread on toast. Eat while fresh.
Reduce the amount of salt if you like.
Season the chicken, then wrap it in foil for later.
